question: Who is the author of the book 'An Era of Darkness: The British Empire in India'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shashi Tharoor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shashi Tharoor**
 
• An **author, politician, and former international civil servant**.
 
 
• **​'An Era of Darkness: The British Empire in India**
 
 
• Shashi Tharoor won the Sahitya Akademi Award 2019 for his book 'An Era of Darkness: The British Empire in India' on December 18, 2019.
 
• **​**This book was published in 2016.
